name: Hellfire Striker raises critical strike and hit chance by 3% (#1168)
contract: Hellfire Striker 573036 reads 'Increases your critical strike and hit chance by $s1%.' Effect 0 is native aura 290 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT), EffectBasePoints 2 with DieSides 1 -> 3; its handler AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct (src/server/game/Spells/Auras/SpellAuraEffects.cpp:355,4892) calls Player::UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras on apply, which recomputes melee/ranged crit chance -- a native, fully generic stat aura. Effect 1 is aura 333 (SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT, a CoA-custom aura type), EffectBasePoints 2 with DieSides 1 -> 3, EffectMiscValue 0; its handler AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:398,4845) is consumed by Player::UpdateMeleeHitChances, UpdateRangedHitChances and UpdateSpellHitChances (src/server/game/Entities/Unit/StatSystem.cpp:997,1003,1009), each reading GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_HIT_CHANCE, SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT) -- a real, wired native consumer already shared by other class passives. Effect 2 (aura 316 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HASTE, base_points 0) is inert and out of the tooltip's stated scope; not asserted. All values verified directly in the installed Spell.dbc.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Force the Hellfire Striker passive aura

CONTRACT: melee crit chance rises by 3 points
CONTRACT: melee hit chance rises by 3 points
CONTRACT: spell hit chance rises by 3 points
